341: One who has learnt only to get entangled in useless disputes, and never how to get free,
stays lost in misgivings all his life, and his life is not accepted.
What use is it to argue on and on, instructing others?
By debating one gains only the habit of debate. ॥15॥
ਞੰਞਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਜੁ ਘਟ ਰਹਿਓ; ਦੂਰਿ; ਕਹਾ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Lord lives close by, in your heart; where do you go, leaving Him for somewhere far?
ਜਾ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਜਗੁ ਢੂਢਿਅਉ; ਨੇਰਉ ਪਾਇਅਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
He for whose sake we searched the whole world has been found near, within. ॥16॥
The landing that leads to God's palace is hard to reach, yet it lies within the heart.
ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ; ਮਹਲਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Why do you not open the shutters (of attachment to Maya) and enter God's presence?
ਦੇਖਿ ਅਟਲ; ਟਲਿ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
One who has seen the ever-unmoving Lord within does not waver or go anywhere else;
he stays clinging to the Lord and wins closeness with Him in the heart. ॥17॥
This Maya is like sand that looks like water from far off.
Looking at it closely, I have made my mind steady.
ਜਿਨਿ ਠਗਿ ਠਗਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਵਾ ॥
The cheat that has deceived the whole world and brought it all under its sway,
ਸੋ ਠਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ; ਠਉਰ ਮਨੁ ਆਵਾ ॥੧੮॥
that cheat I have brought under control, and my mind has come to rest. ॥18॥
When the fear of God arises in the heart, worldly fear departs,
ਤਾ ਡਰ ਮਹਿ; ਡਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
and in that fear the fear of the world comes to an end.
ਜਉ ਡਰ ਡਰੈ; ਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਰੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
But if a person shuns the fear of God, worldly fear clings to him again.
ਨਿਡਰ ਹੂਆ; ਡਰੁ ਉਰ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧੯॥
One who has become fearless finds every dread of his heart take flight. ॥19॥
God is right beside you; where else are you searching for Him?
Searching outside, your very breath has grown weary.
When a person has climbed even Mount Sumer to seek Him and then comes back to look within,
ਜਿਹ ਗੜੁ ਗੜਿਓ; ਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੦॥
he finds the One who built this fort of the body inside the fort itself. ॥20॥
ਣਾਣਾ. ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ; ਨਰ ਨੇਹੀ ਕਰੈ ॥
One who, engaged on the battlefield of this world, gains the strength to master the vices,
who neither bows to them nor makes terms with them,
his life alone the world counts as blessed,
for he kills the one, his mind, and leaves the many vices behind. ॥21॥
This world is a sea hard to swim, and it cannot be crossed
so long as the senses stay sunk in the pleasures of the world.
But when the world's pleasures die away within the body,
ਤਉ. ਤਤਹਿ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੨॥
then the soul merges in God's light and the ever-abiding Lord is found. ॥22॥
The mind cannot find the bottom of the fathomless Lord,
ਓਹੁ ਅਥਾਹ; ਇਹੁ ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
for He is boundlessly deep and this mind never stays still.
On a small plot it starts to raise whole towns, spreading many schemes in a short life,
and it is all in vain, like building a house with no pillars. ॥23॥
All this world that the eyes can see is bound to perish,
so keep your awareness on the Lord who cannot be seen with these eyes.
But only when the key (of the Guru's word) is put to the tenth door
can the merciful Lord be seen. ॥24॥
The soul's round of birth and death is ended only in oneness with God,
when the soul comes to make its dwelling in Him.
When the soul leaves the low state, attachment to Maya, and reaches the high one,
ਤਉ ਅਰਧਹਿ ਉਰਧ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨੫॥
then it meets God and finds real peace. ॥25॥
One whose days and nights pass in watching for the sight of God
finds his eyes, through that watching, drunk with longing for the sight.
When, after long yearning, the sight is at last granted,
the Beloved Lord unites with Himself the lover who longed to see Him. ॥26॥
God is greater than all, and no one has found His limit.
One who has joined in love with the Lord, the source of light,
brings all five senses so fully under control
that he puts both sin and merit behind him. ॥27॥
If a person stops priding himself, he gains the fruit (for which this life was given).
ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ; ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
And if someone grasps even a glimmer of that divine understanding
and reflects on it, he does not fall into the pit of birth and death,
ਤਾ ਫਲ ਫੰਕ; ਸਭੈ ਤਨ ਫਾਰੈ ॥੨੮॥
for even that small glimmer wholly ends his pride in the body. ॥28॥
As one drop of water merges into another,
so the soul that has known God even for an instant cannot be parted from Him.
One who becomes God's servant and lovingly takes up His devotion
342: becomes a bard at His door and learns the secret of the chains (of Maya). ॥29॥
One who ends the gap between himself and God and joins his mind to God's remembrance
has his worldly fear dispelled by it and comes to trust in the Lord.
The God who pervades the whole world he knows to be dwelling within him,
and as this secret opens to him he comes to know the Lord, the Master of creation. ॥30॥
If we lodge the Root of the world in the mind, the mind stops wandering.
ਮਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ. ਮਨ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
One who learns this secret understands the mind and its restless running.
So when the mind begins to join with God, let no one delay,
ਮਗਨ ਭਇਆ ਤੇ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੧॥
for it becomes absorbed in Him and gains that ever-abiding Lord. ॥31॥
ਮਮਾ. ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਹੈ; ਮਨ ਸਾਧੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Each soul's real business is with the mind, and only by mastering the mind does it succeed.
ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ, ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰਾ; ਮਨ ਸਾ. ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੨॥
Says Kabir: its business is with the mind alone; it has met nothing else like the mind. ॥32॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਕਤੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਉ ॥
Joined to Maya this mind becomes Maya; joined to the blissful Lord it becomes the blissful Lord.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
Joined to the body this mind becomes the body itself.
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਲੇ; ਜਉ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
But when a person takes hold of this mind and rests in full flowering,
ਤਉ; ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਕੀ ਬਾਤੈ ਕਹੈ ॥੩੩॥
then he speaks only of the Lord who pervades the whole world. ॥33॥
ਯਯਾ. ਜਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ, ਤਉ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਨਿ; ਕਰਿ ਬਸਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਗਾਉ ॥
If you want to know the right way to live, destroy your bad thinking and bring the village of the body under your control.
ਰਣਿ ਰੂਤਉ. ਭਾਜੈ ਨਹੀ; ਸੂਰਉ. ਥਾਰਉ ਨਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
Only if you engage in this battle and do not flee can your name be hero. ॥34॥
One who has found the savour of Maya to be flat,
keeping clear of its savours, has come to know that spiritual savour.
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਛਾਡੇ; ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਾ ॥
Whoever gives up these savours gains that savour of God's Name,
ਉਹ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ; ਇਹ ਰਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੩੫॥
for one who has drunk that savour finds no pleasure in this one. ॥35॥
If a person's mind fixes its attention on God with such single focus
ਅਨਤ ਨ ਜਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
that it strays nowhere else, he meets the highest, ever-abiding Lord.
ਅਰੁ ਜਉ ਤਹਾ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
And if in that state of attention he keeps up an unbroken flow of love,
ਤਉ ਅਲਹ ਲਹੈ; ਲਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੩੬॥
he finds the Unfindable Lord and, having found Him, stays at His feet for ever. ॥36॥
By keeping God always in the heart,
a soul does not come away having lost the game of human life.
ਬਲਿ; ਬਲਿ; ਜੇ ਬਿਸਨਤਨਾ, ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
I give myself over to the devotee who sings God's praises.
ਵਿਸਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩੭॥
Meeting God, he sees the ever-abiding Lord in every place. ॥37॥
ਵਾਵਾ. ਵਾਹੀ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਵਾ ਜਾਨੇ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
It is that Lord we should come to know; knowing Him, this soul becomes His very form.
ਇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਓਹੁ. ਜਬ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਬ ਮਿਲਤ. ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੮॥
When this soul and that Lord become one, no one else can tell the two apart. ॥38॥
Hold that God carefully in your keeping.
Bring your mind to the words that settle it in God.
When, with the mind settled in Him, love springs up within,
then the King of the three worlds is seen filling every place. ॥39॥
If someone gives himself to the search for God,
ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ; ਸੋ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
whoever finds Him this way is not born or dying again.
One who understands God's qualities and calls them to mind again and again
ਤਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਤ; ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ਬਾਰਾ ॥੪੦॥
takes no time to cross the sea of the world. ॥40॥
That soul-bride adorns the bed of her Husband Lord in her heart,
and that friend alone clears away her doubts,
ਅਲਪ ਸੁਖ ਛਾਡਿ; ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
who gives up the shallow pleasures of the world and gains the highest joy.
ਤਬ ਇਹ ਤ੍ਰੀਅ; ਓੁਹੁ. ਕੰਤੁ ਕਹਾਵਾ ॥੪੧॥
Then truly she is called the wife and He the Husband. ॥41॥
Born human, the soul has not recognised the Lord who truly exists.
ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ; ਤਬਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
Only when it becomes sure of His existence does its mind come to rest in Him.
ਹੈ ਤਉ ਸਹੀ; ਲਖੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਈ ॥
He certainly exists, but it is when someone grasps this
ਤਬ ਓਹੀ ਉਹੁ; ਏਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪੨॥
that the soul becomes His very form and is no longer a separate being. ॥42॥
ਲਿੰਉ ਲਿੰਉ ਕਰਤ; ਫਿਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
The whole world goes about crying, let me gather Maya, let me hoard it,
and for the sake of that Maya great anxiety overtakes the soul.
ਲਖਿਮੀ ਬਰ ਸਿਉ; ਜਉ ਲਿਉ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
But when it joins in love with God, the Master of Maya,
ਸੋਗੁ ਮਿਟੈ; ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੪੩॥
its anxiety ends and it gains every comfort. ॥43॥
Many of the soul's births have gone by in dying and wasting away,
yet, caught in that round, it still does not remember God.
ਅਬ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿ; ਜਉ ਮਨਾ ਰਹੈ ॥
If now, in this birth, it sees the world for what it is and its mind settles in God,
ਜਹ ਕਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਾ; ਤਹ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੪੪॥
it can find a resting place in the One from whom it was parted. ॥44॥
343: With the fifty-two letters the world has written its books,
yet through them it has not come to know the One who never perishes.
O Kabir, one who uses these letters to praise the Lord
is the real pandit, and he stays in the state of knowing.
For pandits these letters are just a trade, strung together to recite to others;
for the wise they are a means of reflecting on the reality.
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ; ਜੈਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
Whatever kind of understanding a person has within,
says Kabir, that is all he will grasp, even with these letters. ॥45॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਥਿਤੀੰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀੰ ॥
The superstitious observe the fifteen lunar days and the seven days of the week,
but Kabir on these days praises the Lord who has no limit.
Whoever, practising that praise, learns the secret of the Lord
sees the luminous Creator, Himself alone, in every place. ॥1॥
On the day of the new moon, put away your hopes in fasts and the like,
and hold in your heart the all-pervading God who knows every heart.
You will win release in this very life,
your own pure essence will kindle and the Guru's word will rise in you as direct experience. ॥1॥
One who comes to love the beautiful feet of Gobind
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ. ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
has his mind made pure by the Guru's grace and, joined to God's praise, stays alert at all hours. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Reflect on the qualities of that Beloved,
who is not confined in bodies, is boundless, and yet plays in every body.
One who praises Him is never touched by the dread of death,
for he stays joined to the Timeless Being, the Creator of all. ॥2॥
He understands that this world has two parts,
Maya and Brahm, and that Brahm lives with everyone.
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਢੈ; ਨ ਘਟਤਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
Brahm never grows and never lessens;
He has no lineage, Maya cannot touch Him, and He stays ever the same. ॥3॥
One who praises God keeps Maya's three qualities in balance and is not shaken by them;
he gains the highest spiritual state, the source of bliss.
In the company of the holy the conviction grows in him
that within and without, everywhere, there is always God's light. ॥4॥
On the fourth day, take hold of this restless mind
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਹਹੁ ॥
and never sit in the company of lust and anger.
The God who by Himself fills water and land,
join with His light and repeat the chant that will truly serve you. ॥5॥
This world is a play made of the five elements,
yet the soul is absorbed in two pursuits, wealth and woman.
Rare is the one here who drinks the nectar of God's love;
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ; ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
the dread of old age and death never grips him again. ॥6॥
ਛਠਿ; ਖਟੁ ਚਕ੍ਰ, ਛਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਇ ॥
The five senses and the mind as sixth, this whole company roams about craving the world.
Until a person joins in God's remembrance, they do not settle.
End your wandering and hold to forbearance,
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ; ਸੂਲ ਨ ਸਹਹੁ ॥੭॥
and leave off the long wrangle of rites and duties, which yields nothing. ॥7॥
Put your faith in the Guru's word,
and through it thread God's Name into your heart.
Then dread departs and sufferings are wiped out;
you bathe in the pool where no such thoughts arise, and enjoy peace. ॥8॥
This body is made of eight ingredients,
ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਅਕੁਲ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
and in it lives the Lord who has no lineage and is the treasury of all virtues.
One to whom the wisdom of the Guru, who has reached God, tells this secret
turns back from attachment to the body and stays joined to the imperishable, unpierceable Lord. ॥9॥
Keep all the body's senses under control,
hold back the thoughts that flow from them,
and forget greed, attachment and every such vice.
344: ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਵਹੁ; ਅਮਰ ਫਲ ਖਾਹੁ ॥੧੦॥
You will live a life that lasts for ever and gain a fruit that never runs out. ॥10॥
For one united with God there is joy throughout the whole world.
The mind's wandering ends and that God is met
who is pure light, the essence of all the world, with none like Him,
ਅਮਲ. ਨ ਮਲ ਨ; ਛਾਹ ਨਹੀ ਧੂਪ ॥੧੧॥
in whom there is no stain of vice, no darkness of ignorance and no fire of craving. ॥11॥
When a person's mind turns towards the one God alone,
ਤਉ ਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਕਟ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
he does not come again into the pains of birth and death.
Coolness settles within him and his whole self becomes pure.
The God who was said to be far off he finds close by, within himself. ॥12॥
Within one joined to the one Lord it is as if twelve suns have risen,
and day and night music sounds in him without a break.
He sees the Master of the three worlds,
and a wonder comes about: from an ordinary person he becomes the form of God. ॥13॥
and so recognises Him as present alike throughout the world.
No one seems low or high to him, and honour and dishonour are the same,
for he sees God pervading all beings. ॥14॥
in its every particle, the Lord is dwelling.
So foster a mind for serving others and for being content with what God has given you.
Speak of His praises, so that this understanding of His true nature stays with you. ॥15॥
As on the night of the full moon the whole moon rises in the sky with all its phases showing,
so the light of inner poise will dawn within you,
ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ; ਹੋਇ ਰਹਿਆ ਥੀਰ ॥
if in the God who abides at the beginning, the end and between,
that ocean of peace, you immerse yourself in remembrance, O Kabir. ॥16॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੇ ੭ ॥
ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
At all times I sing the praises of God;
ਗੁਰ ਗਮਿ ਭੇਦੁ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
reaching the Guru's feet I have found this secret by which God is met. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
For one who begins devotion to God,
that devotion serves as a pillar for the house of the body and steadies the mind's thoughts.
Made fragrant by devotion, his awareness stays joined to God day and night without a break,
ਤਉ ਅਨਹਦ ਬੇਣੁ; ਸਹਜ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਇ ॥੧॥
and then, in that steadiness, a flute plays ceaselessly within the mind. ॥1॥
Singing God's praises, the nectar of peace and coolness rains down in the mind;
on tasting it the mind at once throws off all its vices.
Held back by the Guru's word, the mind stays at God's door
and, intoxicated, goes on drinking that nectar. ॥2॥
A person builds a fort of praise around his mind
and learns how the five thieves make their attack.
Do not leave this fort and go outside,
or else the mind will suffer greatly. ॥3॥
A person kindles the light of God's Name in his understanding
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਸ ॥
and makes a home for God in the lotus of the heart;
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਦੋਊ ਏਕ ਸਮ ਧਰੈ ॥
meeting the Guru he brings the soul and God together,
and takes the mind that was turned towards Maya and sets it facing God. ॥4॥
A person washes away the hold of Maya in the stream of praise
and merges Maya's three qualities in the one Lord.
Those who live in vexation over Maya flounder in the three rivers of its qualities;
day and night they do evil deeds and never wash them off. ॥5॥
ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਾਰੈ; ਸੁ ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਚੜੈ ॥
A person makes this good earning of praise his support and climbs the hard pass
of fighting with his own self at every hour.
He keeps all five senses under control,
ਤਉ ਦੂਜੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਨ ਪੈਸੈ ਕਬੈ ॥੬॥
and then his eye never falls on anyone with a sense of mine and yours. ॥6॥
A person keeps safe within himself that light,
ਜੋਤਿ ਦੀ ਵਟੀ; ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਇ ॥
the lovely small flame of divine radiance that is in every heart.
Then within and without there is only that light,
ਤਬ ਹੂਆ; ਸਗਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
and in this state all the traces of his past deeds are destroyed. ॥7॥
345: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ; ਦੂਜੀ ਆਨ ॥
As long as the craving for worldly honour stays in a person's heart,
ਤਉ ਲਉ; ਮਹਲਿ. ਨ ਲਾਭੈ ਜਾਨ ॥
he cannot join himself to the Lord's feet.
By remembering the Lord again and again, love for Him grows,
and, says Kabir, then the body becomes pure. ॥8॥1॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਚੇਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O God, You made even stones float,
ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ; ਜਨ ਕਸ ਨ ਤਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so why would those who utter Your Name not cross over? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਾਰੀਲੇ ਗਨਿਕਾ, ਬਿਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਕੁਬਿਜਾ; ਬਿਆਧਿ ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
You saved the prostitute, took away the ugliness of misshapen Kubija, and carried across Ajamal, sunk in vice.
ਚਰਨ ਬਧਿਕ; ਜਨ ਤੇਊ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਏ ॥
The hunter who shot Krishna in the foot, and many such people, were set free.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ; ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਕਹੇ ॥੧॥
I give myself up to those who have remembered the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਦਰੁ. ਸੁਦਾਮਾ; ਉਗ੍ਰਸੈਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ਦੀਏ ॥
Bidar, a slave-girl's son, became Your devotee; so did Sudama; and to Ugrasen You gave a kingdom.
ਜਪ ਹੀਨ. ਤਪ ਹੀਨ. ਕੁਲ ਹੀਨ. ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੀਨ; ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਊ ਤਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
O Master of Namdev, even those with no recitation, no austerity, no high family and no good deeds have crossed over. ॥2॥1॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਪਦੇ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੇਰੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੋਚ; ਸੋਚ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Day and night I worry: the company I keep is bad,
crookedness is my daily work, and my birth is low. ॥1॥
O my Lord, Master of the earth, support of my life,
ਮੋਹਿ. ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ; ਮੈ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
do not forget me; I am Your servant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਹੁ ਬਿਪਤਿ; ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
Cut away this distress of mine and make me, Your servant, well-disposed;
ਚਰਣ ਨ ਛਾਡਉ; ਸਰੀਰ ਕਲ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
I will not leave Your feet, even if the strength of my body goes. ॥2॥
Says Ravidas: I have come to Your shelter,
ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਨ; ਕਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਂਬਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
meet Your servant soon; do not delay. ॥3॥1॥
The name of that city is Begampura, the place without sorrow;
in that place there is no pain and no worry,
no agitation, no worldly property and no tax upon it;
ਖਉਫੁ ਨ ਖਤਾ; ਨ ਤਰਸੁ ਜਵਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
no danger of doing wrong, no fear and no decline. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ; ਖੂਬ ਵਤਨ ਗਹ ਪਾਈ ॥
Now I have found a fine place to live,
ਊਹਾਂ ਖੈਰਿ ਸਦਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
where, my brother, there is always wellbeing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
It is a kingdom that stands for ever;
ਦੋਮ ਨ ਸੇਮ; ਏਕ ਸੋ ਆਹੀ ॥
no one there is of second or third rank, all are alike.
That city is always renowned and well peopled,
and those who live there are rich and contented. ॥2॥
ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੈਲ ਕਰਹਿ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Those who reach it move about in joy, just as they please;
they know the secrets of the palace, so no one bars their way.
Says Ravidas the cobbler: whoever has won release
ਜੋ ਹਮ ਸਹਰੀ; ਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
and shares our city is our friend. ॥3॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਘਟ ਅਵਘਟ ਡੂਗਰ ਘਣਾ; ਇਕੁ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਬੈਲੁ ਹਮਾਰ ॥
The paths are steep and mountainous, and my one ox is feeble;
ਰਮਈਏ ਸਿਉ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
I make one plea to the dear Lord: guard my capital Yourself. ॥1॥
ਕੋ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਮੇਰਾ ਟਾਂਡਾ ਲਾਦਿਆ ਜਾਇ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If I meet some trader in the Lord's Name, my goods too can be loaded. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
346: ਹਉ ਬਨਜਾਰੋ. ਰਾਮ ਕੋ; ਸਹਜ ਕਰਉ ਬੵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
I am a trader in the Lord's Name, and the trade I do earns me inner poise.
ਮੈ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਾਦਿਆ; ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
I have loaded the goods of the Lord's Name, while the world has loaded poison. ॥2॥
ਉਰਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਕੇ ਦਾਨੀਆ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਲ ਪਤਾਲੁ ॥
O recorders who know every deed of this world and the next, write whatever you like about me;
ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗਈ; ਤਜੀਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
the rod of Death cannot fall on me, for I have dropped all entanglements. ॥3॥
ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ; ਤੈਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
This world is like the colour of safflower,
ਮੇਰੇ ਰਮਈਏ. ਰੰਗੁ ਮਜੀਠ ਕਾ; ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੪॥੧॥
and the colour of my dear Lord's Name is like madder, says Ravidas the cobbler. ॥4॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕੂਪੁ ਭਰਿਓ ਜੈਸੇ ਦਾਦਿਰਾ; ਕਛੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਬਿਦੇਸੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝ ॥
As frogs filling a well have no idea that any land lies beyond it,
ਐਸੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਮੋਹਿਆ; ਕਛੁ ਆਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝ ॥੧॥
so my mind is so caught in Maya that it sees neither the near bank nor the far. ॥1॥
ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕਾ; ਇਕੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇ ਜੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O chief of all the worlds, show me Yourself for just a moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਲਿਨ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ. ਮਾਧਵਾ; ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ. ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
O Lord, my understanding is soiled, so I cannot grasp what You are like.
ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਈ; ਮੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੨॥
Have mercy and teach me good sense, so that my wandering ends. ॥2॥
ਜੋਗੀਸਰ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਨਹੀ; ਤੁਅ ਗੁਣ ਕਥਨੁ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
Even great yogis cannot find the end of Your boundless virtues,
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਣੈ; ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰ ॥੩॥੧॥
but, O Ravidas the cobbler, praise Him, so that you may receive love and devotion. ॥3॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਤਜੁਗਿ ਸਤੁ. ਤੇਤਾ ਜਗੀ; ਦੁਆਪਰਿ ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ॥
You say charity led in Satyug, sacrifices in Treta and the worship of gods in Duapar;
ਤੀਨੌ ਜੁਗ ਤੀਨੌ ਦਿੜੇ; ਕਲਿ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
so three ages stress these three, and in Kaliyug the Name alone is the support. ॥1॥
But how will you find the far shore?
ਮੋ ਸਉ; ਕੋਊ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
None of you has explained to me the practice
ਜਾ ਤੇ; ਆਵਾ ਗਵਨੁ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by which the round of birth and death ends. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਰੂਪੀਐ; ਕਰਤਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
Duties are laid out in many ways, and the whole world is seen performing them.
ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਜਿਹ ਸਾਧੇ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
But which deed brings release, and which, once done, makes life succeed? ॥2॥
ਕਰਮ ਅਕਰਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ; ਸੰਕਾ ਸੁਨਿ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
People weigh which acts are enjoined and which forbidden, yet hearing the Vedas and Puranas only adds to doubt.
ਸੰਸਾ ਸਦ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸੈ; ਕਉਨੁ ਹਿਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
Dread stays lodged in the heart; which rite takes away pride? ॥3॥
ਬਾਹਰੁ ਉਦਕਿ ਪਖਾਰੀਐ; ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Only the outside is washed with water, while many kinds of vice remain in the heart;
ਸੁਧ ਕਵਨ ਪਰ ਹੋਇਬੋ; ਸੁਚ ਕੁੰਚਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੪॥
who becomes pure that way? Such cleanliness is like an elephant's bath. ॥4॥
ਰਵਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ. ਰਜਨੀ ਜਥਾ ਗਤਿ; ਜਾਨਤ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
The whole world knows how night departs once the sun is up.
ਪਾਰਸ ਮਾਨੋ ਤਾਬੋ ਛੁਏ; ਕਨਕ ਹੋਤ. ਨਹੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੫॥
Keep in mind too that copper touched by the philosopher's stone turns to gold without delay. ॥5॥
ਪਰਮ ਪਰਸ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ; ਪੂਰਬ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥
When earlier destiny awakes, one meets the Guru, the finest philosopher's stone of all.
ਉਨਮਨ. ਮਨ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਿਲੇ; ਛੁਟਕਤ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੬॥
A longing for God rises in the mind, He is met within, and the mind's hard doors swing open. ॥6॥
ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ. ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰੀ; ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
One who, joined to devotion, has cut away wandering, vice and bondage and so steadied his understanding,
ਸੋਈ ਬਸਿ ਰਸਿ. ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ; ਗੁਨ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੭॥
he alone, settled and joyful, meets the Lord within, and dwells on the virtues of the One beyond Maya's three qualities. ॥7॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੀਏ; ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਫਾਸ ॥
Try countless other ways of restraining the mind, and still the noose of wandering does not come off.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੮॥੧॥
Loving devotion does not arise through them, and so Ravidas has turned away from such rites. ॥8॥1॥
347: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧; ਘਰੁ ੧ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ॥
ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ. ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ; ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
How wondrous is that gate, that home, where You sit and look after all.
ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Countless are the instruments and sounds, and endless those who play them.
ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
Endless ragas with their raginis are named, and many are the singers of them.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ; ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
Air, water and fire sing of You; Dharamraj praises You at Your door.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ; ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Chitragupta, who know how to write the accounts that Dharamraj weighs, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ; ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
Shiva, Brahma and the goddesses, adorned by You and shining, sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ; ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Many an Indra seated on his throne praises You at Your door, along with the gods.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Siddhas sing of You in their trances; the holy praise You through reflection.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ; ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
The continent, the givers and the contented sing Your virtues, and so do sturdy heroes.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਬੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
Learned pandits and great sages sing of You, together with the Vedas.
ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ; ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Beautiful women who captivate the mind sing of You; heaven, earth and the underworld sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੇਤੇ; ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
All the jewels You have made sing of You, along with the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ; ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
Warriors and heroes of great strength praise You; the creatures of all four sources of life sing of You.
ਗਾਵਨੑਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ. ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The whole creation, its regions and spheres, made and held in place by You, sing of You.
ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨੑਿ. ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨੑਿ; ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
In truth only those sing of You who please You, Your devotees steeped in Your love.
ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ. ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ, ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵਨਿ; ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
So many others sing of You that I cannot even count them; what can Nanak consider?
ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
That God is ever-abiding, that Master is true, and His greatness never fails.
ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ. ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
He who made this creation is here now and always will be; He was not born and will not die.
ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
He who made Maya in its many colours, kinds and forms
ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਪਣਾ; ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
makes and looks after what He has made, as suits His own greatness.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
He does whatever pleases Him; no one can give Him an order.
348: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥੧॥
He is the King, the King of kings, the Master; O Nanak, our place is to live within His will. ॥1॥1॥
ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
That God pervades all yet stands above Maya's influence; He is out of reach and without limit.
ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ. ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
O ever-abiding Creator, all beings remember You.
ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
All beings are Yours, and You provide for them all.
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
O holy ones, remember that Lord, who destroys every sorrow.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ; ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
He Himself is the Master and Himself the servant; O Nanak, what are poor creatures apart from Him? ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
O Lord, You are within every body, present in all without a break; You alone fill them all.
ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ. ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ; ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
Some are givers and some are beggars: all this is Your wondrous play.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ. ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ; ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
You Yourself give and You Yourself use what is given; I recognise no one but You.
ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ. ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ; ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
You are the limitless supreme God; which of Your virtues could I name and tell?
ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨੑ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
O Lord, servant Nanak gives himself up to those who remember You. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ; ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਸੀ ॥
O Lord, those who remember You live their lives in peace.
ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ. ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ ਟੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Those who have remembered the Lord are freed for good, and for them Death's noose is broken.
ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
From those who have dwelt on the fearless Lord, He takes all fear away.
ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ. ਜਿਨੑ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
Those who have remembered my dear Lord are merged in His own form.
ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ. ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Fortunate, truly fortunate, are those who have dwelt on the Lord; servant Nanak gives himself up to them. ॥3॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ. ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ; ਭਰੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
O Lord, the treasuries of Your devotion stand full beyond measure.
ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ. ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
O Lord, Your countless devotees keep praising You.
ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ. ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ, ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ; ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
Many worship You, O Lord, and endless numbers practise austerities.
ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ. ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
Many of Yours read the Simritis and Shastras and carry out the six duties and other rites.
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ. ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ; ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
O servant Nanak, those devotees are good who are dear to the beloved Lord. ॥4॥
ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
O Lord, You are the source of all, all-pervading, limitless, the Creator; no one is as great as You.
ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ. ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
In every age You alone are, always the One; You never change, and You create and care for all.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
Only what You Yourself approve takes place; only what You Yourself do comes about.
ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ; ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
You Yourself brought forth the whole creation, and having made it You Yourself destroy it.
ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ; ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੨॥
Servant Nanak sings the virtues of the Creator, who knows what is in every heart. ॥5॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Everyone says You are great merely from hearing it said,
but how great You are can be told only by one who has seen You.
349: Your greatness cannot be assessed, and it cannot be told;
those who speak of it are lost in You. ॥1॥
ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
O my great Master, You are deep, large-hearted, and full of endless virtues.
ਕੋਈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
No one knows how far Your expanse reaches. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those famed for trance joined together and strained their concentration again and again,
and together tried to find something equal to You;
renowned scholars and thinkers helped one another in the attempt,
ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
yet they could not tell even a grain of Your greatness. ॥2॥
ਸਭਿ ਸਤ. ਸਭਿ ਤਪ; ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
All good deeds, all austerities, all good qualities,
and the great feats of the Siddhas:
ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ; ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
no one has achieved such success without Your help.
It comes by Your grace, and then no one can stand in its way. ॥3॥
What standing has a poor creature to describe them?
Your treasuries are full of virtues.
ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
No one has the power to obstruct a person to whom You give the gift of praise,
for, O Nanak, the ever-abiding Lord Himself sets him right. ॥4॥1॥
As I utter the Name, spiritual life grows in me; when I forget it, spiritual death sets in.
Even so, remembering the ever-abiding Name is hard.
When hunger for the ever-abiding Name arises in someone,
by that hunger he feeds on the Name and all his sorrows go. ॥1॥
O my mother, may I never forget Him.
As we remember the Name of the ever-abiding One, that ever-abiding Master comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Even a grain of the greatness of the ever-abiding Lord's Name
is more than anyone can tell, though all have tired trying; no one can say what equals Him.
ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ; ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
If every being joined together to try to describe Him,
ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
He would grow no greater, nor would He grow less. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ; ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
He never dies, and there is no mourning for Him.
He keeps on giving, and the use of His gifts never runs out.
His great quality is this: there is no other like Him,
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
none has been and none will ever be. ॥3॥
As great as You are Yourself, so great is Your giving,
ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
You who made the day and made the night.
Those who forget such a Master become base in nature.
O Nanak, those who miss the Name are the lowly ones. ॥4॥2॥
ਜੇ ਦਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਤੁ ਕੂਕ ਕਰੇ; ਮਹਲੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
If a beggar cries out at the door, the Master of the palace hears him.
ਭਾਵੈ ਧੀਰਕ, ਭਾਵੈ ਧਕੇ; ਏਕ. ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
Whether He chooses to encourage or to push away, in hearing the plea He is granting honour. ॥1॥
ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜੋਤਿ. ਨ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਤੀ; ਆਗੈ. ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
See the one light in everyone and do not ask about caste; no caste goes along to the world beyond. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God Himself prompts the cry and Himself makes it,
and He Himself listens to the complaints.
When You make someone sure that You, the Creator, can do everything,
he depends on no one, and the world can do him no harm. ॥2॥
God Himself creates beings and Himself provides for them.
He Himself holds them back from bad thinking.
One in whose mind He comes to dwell by the Guru's grace
is rid of suffering within, and his ignorance is gone. ॥3॥
God Himself makes remembrance of Him dear to people;
to others, in whom love is still lacking, He does not give that gift.
ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇਇ, ਵਖਾਣੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਆਗੈ. ਪੂਛ ਨ ਲੇਇ ॥੪॥੩॥
Says Nanak: from anyone to whom He gives it, no account of deeds is asked hereafter. ॥4॥3॥
The mind's restless thoughts are the cymbals and ankle-bells,
attachment to the world is the drum, and these instruments are playing,
while the mind dances: such is the influence of Kaliyug.
Continence and virtue have nowhere left to set foot. ॥1॥
O Nanak, give yourself up to the Name of God.
The world has gone blind; the Master alone can see. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Now it is the disciple who feeds off the Guru,
and he becomes a disciple only for the sake of bread.
350: Even if a person lives a hundred years, eating in comfort,
only that day counts on which he comes to know his Master. ॥2॥
People feel no kindness on seeing one another;
ਲਏ ਦਿਤੇ ਵਿਣੁ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
no one goes without taking and giving bribes.
Even the king gives justice only when there is something in the petitioner's hand;
if someone pleads in God's name alone, nobody listens. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: he has the form of a man, and is a man in name only,
but in conduct he is a dog, obeying orders at the master's door.
If by the Guru's grace he knows himself to be a guest in the world,
only then does he win some honour in God's presence. ॥4॥4॥
ਜੇਤਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਸੁਰਤਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੇਤੀ; ਜੇਤਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
All the speaking and hearing there is comes from Your life-current; all the form that is seen is Your body.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਰਸਨਾ. ਆਪੇ ਬਸਨਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਹਉ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
You Yourself are the one who tastes, You Yourself are the life in all; O mother, I can speak of no other beside Him. ॥1॥
My Master is the One alone,
ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the One alone, brother; there is no other like Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ; ਆਪੇ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
He Himself kills and He Himself spares; He Himself takes life and gives it.
ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ. ਆਪੇ ਵਿਗਸੈ; ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
He Himself looks after all and Himself delights in it; He Himself casts His glance of grace. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
Whatever is happening He Himself is doing; nothing can be done by anyone else.
ਜੈਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ. ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
As He acts, so He is named; all that is seen is the display of Your greatness. ॥3॥
ਕਲਿ ਕਲਵਾਲੀ, ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਲਾ, ਪੀਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
The spirit of Kaliyug is the wine-seller and Maya the sweet wine; the drunken mind keeps on drinking.
ਆਪੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਂਤੀਂ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ. ਏਵ ਕਹੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
He Himself makes these forms of many kinds; this is all poor Nanak can say. ॥4॥5॥
One who makes sound understanding his instrument and love of God his drum
has joy within always, and eagerness in his mind.
This is real devotion, and this the great austerity.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੧॥
Stay in this joy and keep to life's path; dance this dance. ॥1॥
One who knows how to praise God dances in perfect time;
ਹੋਰੁ ਨਚਣਾ; ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
every other dance is only the mind's own pleasure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Let service and contentment be the two cymbals that sound,
let being always cheerful be the bells on the feet,
and let having no other attachment be the melody and the song.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
Stay in this joy and keep to life's path; dance this dance. ॥2॥
Let the whirling be this: awe of God held in mind and heart,
sitting and rising, at every moment;
and let the rolling on the ground be knowing the body to be perishable.
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
Stay in this joy and keep to life's path; dance this dance. ॥3॥
Growing love for the Guru's teaching in the gathering of the holy,
hearing the eternal Name while turned towards the Guru,
repeating God's Name over and over:
ਇਤੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਾਚਹੁ; ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਪੈਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
O Nanak, stay in this joy and set your feet on this path; dance this dance. ॥4॥6॥
ਪਉਣੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੀ ਸਭ ਧਰਤੀ; ਜਲ ਅਗਨੀ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
God made the air, set the whole earth in place, and bound water and fire together.
ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਦਹਸਿਰਿ ਮੂੰਡੁ ਕਟਾਇਆ; ਰਾਵਣੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
Ravan, blind in mind, brought his own beheading on himself; God did not become great just by killing Ravan. ॥1॥
Your greatness cannot be put into words.
ਤੂੰ ਸਰਬੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are present in all, filling every being. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹਥਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਕਾਲੀ ਨਥਿ ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥
You created all beings and hold their way of life in Your hand; You did not become great just by putting a nose-string on the serpent Kali.
ਕਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਪੁਰਖੁ. ਜੋਰੂ ਕਉਣ ਕਹੀਐ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
You are no one woman's husband, and no woman is Your wife; You are present within all without a break. ॥2॥
ਨਾਲਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਰਦਾਤਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਭਾਲਣ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
Brahma, born from the lotus stalk with Vishnu as his helper, went out to find the limit of creation,
ਆਗੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ, ਤਾ ਕਾ; ਕੰਸੁ ਛੇਦਿ. ਕਿਆ ਵਡਾ ਭਇਆ ॥੩॥
but could not find its end; how much greater did the Lord become just by killing Kans? ॥3॥
ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਰੇ, ਖੀਰੁ ਮਥਿਆ; ਹੋਰਿ ਭਖਲਾਏ, ਜਿ ਅਸੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
The ocean was churned and the jewels brought out, and both sides shouted in anger, "We did this."
